meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 能读取和编写 FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 文件；提取事件数据为 NumPy 数组，读取通道与元数据，可导出 CSV/DataFrame，也能把数组新建为 FCS 文件。
howto.when: 当用户提供 FCS 文件，需要解析元数据、提取事件数据、导出表格、创建或改动 FCS 文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我看一下 sample.fcs 的版本、事件数和通道列表
把 flow_data.fcs 的事件数据转成 CSV

say.note: 调用 create_fcs 写出文件

howto.what_en: Read and write FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 files; extract events as NumPy arrays, inspect channels and metadata, export to CSV/DataFrame, and create new FCS files from arrays.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user provides an FCS file for metadata parsing, event extraction, table export, or FCS file creation/modification.

say_en.text: Check the version, event count, and channel list of sample.fcs
Convert flow_data.fcs event data to CSV
Create a new FCS 3.1 file from my array
